required_outcomes: Records the landlord's reply at event 008 as approval for the agency to send its own contractor to look at the kitchen extractor fan.
Assigns a maintenance provider for the extractor fan and instructs them to contact the tenant to arrange a visit.
Tells the tenant (Clara) that the landlord has approved and a contractor will be in touch to book a visit, without promising a specific date.
Takes the case out of the landlord-approval wait and back into normal running, with a follow-up for the provider's visit date.
acceptable_alternatives: Briefly suggesting the tenant first check for an isolation switch for the fan while the contractor is being arranged, as long as the contractor is still instructed.
Sending a short acknowledgement to the landlord confirming a contractor is being arranged.

Returning the ticket to auto mode for provider selection (the workflow's next stage after landlord approval) instead of naming a contractor, when no contractor is on file, provided the approval is recorded and the tenant is told.
positive_behaviours: Passes the tenant's description of the fault and the referenced photo to the provider in the instruction.
Notes in the case record that the landlord chose an agency contractor rather than his own.
red_flags: Asking the landlord again whether he wants to use his own contractor or the agency's, or asking him to re-confirm the approval.
Escalating to a human or placing the case on hold waiting for the landlord when no decision is outstanding.
prohibited_actions: Leaving the case in the landlord-approval wait with no provider assigned after a clear approval.
critical_failures: Ending the turn with no provider assigned and the ticket not returned to provider selection, either by escalating or by re-requesting an approval the landlord has already given.
